prompt:
This is a short sound cut out of a recording of someone talking, from a pause between two words, padded with silence. What is it? Answer with the letter only.
A speech (a word or part of a word)
B filler (um, uh, erm or hmm)
C breath (an inhalation or exhalation)
D laugh
E cough
F sigh
G sniff
H throat clearing
I gasp
J cry
K groan
L sneeze
M yawn
N click (a lip smack or tongue click)
O noise (background sound not made by the speaker)
P silence
